verdict.rationale: Broadcasts and segments let Customer.io send messages or trigger automations to many recipients at once, and the CLI/MCP give AI agents workspace-wide access to automations and segments, implying some multi-item scope. But there's no explicit documentation of a bulk API/CLI command for batch-updating or deleting many profiles/records at once via AI. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoint docs, hands-on evidence of AI performing bulk create/update/delete across many items.
